problem_statement: Return True if values contains any duplicate element, otherwise False. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. Do not modify the input.

bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses range(i + 2, ...) instead of range(i + 1, ...), so adjacent elements are never compared and adjacent duplicates are missed.
